concept.title: The default agents
concept.shortdesc: Every workspace starts with a small, flat team, already arranged:

ul.li: V&V Assistant on top: the general agent you chat with beside the wizard and on every project page. It answers questions, reviews, and proposes any change to the project as a card you apply.
Requirements Auditor: checks requirements and user needs against the project's quality rules, and proposes rewrites.
Test Auditor: checks verification coverage and test cases, and drafts missing test cases with their verifies links. Draft test cases runs it.
Link Auditor: checks traceability (suspect, missing and mistyped links) and proposes fixes.
Requirements Interviewer: holds elicitation interviews with the people you invite.

conbody.p: The three auditors write only proposals: nothing they change lands until someone approves it. Run one from its card with ▶ Launch run, and say what to audit.

A workspace that had the earlier team (Chief of Staff, Requirements Analyst, V&V Engineer, Developer, Reviewer and Test Case Author) moved to this one with the release: those agents were archived, not deleted, so their runs and proposals are kept. An agent your workspace had edited or locked, or that an automation runs, was left as it was; archive it yourself if you no longer need it.
